public.title: Reverse Bits
public.description: Reverse the order of all 32 bits of unsigned integer n and return the unsigned integer represented by those reversed bits. n lies between 0 and 4294967295. Leading zero bits participate in the reversal.
hints: Repeat exactly 32 times, even if the remaining input becomes zero.
Use unsigned coercion after bitwise operations.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Shift one low input bit into the result per iteration. Exactly 32 iterations use O(1) time and space.
